subject: Stickiness checklist: economic path & exec sell-in
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Erica Barnes <erica.barnes@sablehealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@sablehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Stickiness checklist: economic path & exec sell-in

Hi Erica / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking us through the CareOps workflow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Decision criteria we heard
- Primary: reduction in clinician time spent on charting (target 25% per week)
- Secondary: PHI-safe deployment and SOC2 evidence for audit
- Tertiary: 6–9 month TCO payback window

2) People / org path (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Tom Reyes (CFO) — owns budget approval
- Security reviewer: security-lead@sablehealth.com (name? John?)
- Procurement: procurement@sablehealth.com (standard SOW/PO path)

3) Immediate asks from our side
- Can you confirm the security contact (name + preferred evidence cadence)?
- Do you want a short one-page exec slide tailored to Tom summarizing ROI and risk mitigations? We can get that to you by EOD tomorrow.
- Proposed next checkpoint: internal procurement + security sync on Thurs, Dec 3 — do you have 30 minutes?

Attached: sable-MAP-outline-v1.pdf (sketch of mutual action plan + timeline). I also dropped a quick cost/volume sensitivity chart in the MAP.

If that matches your expectations I’ll draft a pared-down exec slide and loop Ben/Grace for the ROI bullets.

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: sable-MAP-outline-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Erica Barnes <erica.barnes@sablehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@sablehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@sablehealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stickiness checklist: economic path & exec sell-in

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the summary, that’s helpful and accurate. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Security lead: Laura Ming (laura.ming@sablehealth.com). She asked for SOC2 Type II, data retention policy, and network segmentation notes (ideally a short spreadsheet).
- Procurement: procurement@sablehealth.com (they will request our standard vendor questionnaire + PO terms).
- Confirmed economic buyer: Tom Reyes, CFO — he’ll want a one-page summary focused on EBITDA impact and implementation risk.

We’re happy to do the Thurs sync — 30 minutes works. Can you send a calendar invite for Dec 3 at 11:00am PT?

I attached our IT/security intake doc (Sable-IT-reqs.xlsx). Also yes — please send the exec one-pager. If you can include a short customer quote and the expected timeline to first value, that would help Tom.

Cheers,
Erica
Director, Clinical Ops | Sable Health
erica.barnes@sablehealth.com

Attachment: Sable-IT-reqs.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Erica Barnes <erica.barnes@sablehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stickiness checklist: economic path & exec sell-in

Thanks Erica — looping in a couple of internal bullets that we can use for the exec slide and for Logan to hand to Tom. Pasted below so Erica/Tom can see the language we plan to use.

— 3 ROI bullets (talk-track friendly) —
• 25% clinician time savings (modeled on 10k monthly charts) = ~$420k annual labor savings at current rates; additional downstream reduction in coding overhead.
• 18% reduction in documentation time leads to 12% faster throughput per clinician in Q1 post-rollout (conservative estimate based on Redwood pilot at MedEast).
• Payback: base-case 8 months (includes integration & training), upside to 5 months with batching + prefix caching.

— Security / risk talk-track —
• We provide SOC2 Type II evidence, can redact customer-specific logs; support for customer-managed KMS is available for Private deployments.
• We’ll run a short pen-test questionnaire with Laura and provide a network diagram and dataflow spreadsheet within 3 business days of request.

I attached a short one-pager we typically use for CFOs (redwood-exec-onepager-ROI.docx). Logan — feel free to pick the bullets you want; I can tailor the numbers for Tom once we get volume.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood
Attachment: redwood-exec-onepager-ROI.docx (DOCX, 1 page)
